actualities.title: Suspicious Credential Harvesting Campaign Detected in Laboratory Environment
actualities.summary: A controlled phishing scenario was identified during laboratory monitoring. The campaign simulates credential-harvesting activity targeting users through fraudulent authentication pages.
actualities.content:
Overview

A controlled credential-harvesting campaign was identified during a laboratory cybersecurity exercise conducted within the NG-IDPS environment.

The scenario reproduces a common phishing pattern in which a fraudulent web page attempts to convince a user to enter authentication information.

Technical Analysis

The simulated campaign relies on social-engineering techniques and a deceptive authentication interface.

From a detection perspective, relevant indicators may include:

- Access to suspicious domains or URLs
- Repeated requests to authentication-related endpoints
- Unusual HTTP request patterns
- Redirection to non-approved resources
- Repeated connections from the same source

The NG-IDPS platform can correlate network-based detections with machine-learning anomaly detection and CTI enrichment.

Detection Relevance

This actuality is intended to demonstrate the CTI ingestion pipeline of NG-IDPS.

The published intelligence can be retrieved through the machine-readable CTI feed and consumed by the NG-IDPS CTI agent for classification, semantic enrichment and correlation.

Recommended Actions

1. Monitor authentication-related traffic for unusual patterns.
2. Review suspicious domains and URLs observed during the exercise.
3. Correlate network alerts with endpoint or user activity.
4. Apply relevant detection rules after analyst validation.
5. Continue monitoring for related indicators.

Laboratory Notice

This publication is part of the NG-IDPS laboratory and demonstration environment.

The indicators and scenario described here are controlled demonstration data and must not be interpreted as a report of an active real-world campaign.

actualities.title: Suspicious IP activity targeting corporate VPNs
actualities.summary: Observed cluster of scans and brute-force attempts against corporate VPN endpoints.
actualities.content: Observed repeated connection attempts from multiple IPs belonging to a known scanning range. Indicators suggest automated scanning followed by credential stuffing attempts.

actualities.title: Phishing campaign uses brand impersonation
actualities.summary: A wide phishing campaign impersonating finance brand to harvest credentials.
actualities.content: Multiple phishing emails observed that mimic finance provider. Users in several orgs reported suspicious emails.
